# TogetherList

> Shared lists without sign-up, for people and compatible MCP agents.

Create a free list, share its link and collaborate in a browser. Online updates refresh about every three seconds.

Anyone holding a list link or ID can read and modify that list. Display names are not authentication. Share list access only with people and agents you trust; avoid sensitive information.

## Documentation
- [Landing page](https://togetherlist.eu/): features, MCP workflow and FAQ
- [MCP setup and product details](https://togetherlist.eu/llms-full.txt): transports, tools and access boundaries
- [Privacy](https://togetherlist.eu/privacy): privacy and optional analytics
